understanding: Plan wishbone_bus WISHBONE access coverage from monitor-reconstructed transactions for direction plus DLAB gating normal versus divisor. Reuse checked wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_dat_o wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_ack_o identity map with RTL names for code. DOCUMENTED DLAB bit 7 and 8-bit responder role support partial DLAB mapping; QUICK_TEST_PLAN_APPROVAL address bins and ACK sampling stay INFERRED test-only not engineer sign-off and guide architecture only.
preconditions: Clock stable at selected period and reset deasserted via ordered bring-up
wishbone_bus monitor active reconstructing completed read and write transactions for subscriber tap
LCR DLAB bit 7 state observable for normal versus divisor classification
Base register access stimulus available via t_wb_seq and monitor via t_wb_mon dependencies
stimulus_steps: FOR each symbolic phase in normal_DLAB0 then divisor_DLAB1: DRIVE LCR DLAB to documented 0 or 1 via wishbone_bus
DRIVE symbolic read and write operations via wishbone_bus to exercise shared versus other addresses for coverage
WAIT for wishbone_bus monitor to emit completed transaction before next stimulus
coverage_steps: WAIT for wishbone_bus monitor analysis port to emit observed completed transaction with acknowledge indication [f_wb_8bit]
SAMPLE wb_direction from wb_we_i symbolic read versus write on completed transaction only; never sample driver stimulus
SAMPLE dlab_addr_map from address phase plus LCR DLAB bit 7 state distinguishing normal versus divisor at shared addresses [f_dlab_bit] [f_dlab_one] [f_dlab_zero]
SAMPLE cross wb_addr_x_dlab combining symbolic address with DLAB state for gating interaction
EXCLUDE idle cycles with no framing and unlisted gaps via ignore_bins; terminate sampling on completion timeout
completion: WAIT until all spawned sampling complete OR UNTIL SYM_TIMEOUT_CYCLES expires as TESTBENCH operational limit not DUT timing
DRAIN wishbone_bus monitor for SYM_DRAIN_CYCLES idle cycles for pipeline drain then close sampling
CLEANUP clear coverage sampling state and release observation handles with no driven bus changes

facts.statement: LCR bit 7 is Divisor Latch Access bit RW.
DLAB value 1 allows divisor latches to be accessed.
facts.quote: ‘1’ – The divisor latches can be accessed

facts.statement: DLAB value 0 selects normal registers access.
UART core uses 8-bit data bus for compatibility as WISHBONE responder.
facts.quote: It has an 8-bit data bus for compatibility reason.

What are active and idle levels of wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_ack_o, transaction framing, single ACK rule, and sampling clock edge for direction and acknowledge coverage?
What is expected behavior of other addresses 2 to 6 while DLAB is 1, and of shared addresses 0 to 1 when gating blocks opposite mapping?
What is coverage DLAB state source and ordering: LCR mirror versus uart_config, set-then-clear around divisor access, and MSB-first LSB-next relevance?
What are legal ignore versus illegal bins for idle_no_stb_cyc, addr_7_unused, and unlisted gaps, and confirm per-instance false with wb_sel_i and data validity filtering?
